_description: Customize your statusline appearance. Edit values below to change colors, icons, and behavior.
_themeComment: Set 'theme' to load a preset from themes/ folder (minimal, developer, full). Theme values override config values. Remove or leave empty to use config as-is.

sections._comment: Show or hide sections. Set to true to show, false to hide.

colors._comment: ANSI color codes. Use standard codes (30-37, 90-97) or 256-color codes (38;5;N for foreground, 48;5;N for background)

tokens._comment: Token display and autocompact warning thresholds

warningThresholds._comment: Remaining tokens before color changes (based on 33k autocompact buffer)

sessionCost._comment: Session cost display settings. Pricing (Mar 2026, per million tokens): Haiku 4.5: $1/$5. Sonnet 4.5/4.6: $3/$15. Opus 4.6: $5/$25. Cache write is 1.25x input, cache read is 0.1x input.

modelAliases._comment: Map model display names to shorter labels. Use exact display name as key.

icons._comment: Icons for each section. Set enabled to false to hide all icons, or customize individual icons.

lastMessage._comment: Last message display. style: 'timestamp' (shows time) or 'elapsed' (shows '2m ago'). format: '12h' or '24h' (only for timestamp style)

compact._comment: Auto-trim sections from the right when statusline exceeds terminal width. Set maxWidth to 0 to auto-detect terminal width.

debug._comment: Debug logging to investigate blinking issues. Set enabled to true to log statusline data.

updates._durationComment: Seconds to show update notification in statusline
